text:
michelle: Kicking off a zipper-style ff rollout for `llm_route_v2` — target 20% across cohorts (zipper cadence). Window: 23:00-02:00 UTC. Pinning model version from `model-v2.1.2` -> `model-v2.2.0` for cohorts that switch. Notify SRE if p50 latency > 200ms or errors > 0.5% :warning:

deploy-bot: acked. starting cohort zipper rollout at 23:05 UTC. command: `/deploy ff enable llm_route_v2 --mode zipper --pct 20 --pin model-v2.2.0` 

sam: quick q — what is the cadence between zipper steps? intended 5m or 10m?

michelle: 10m steps, but we'll hold if any signal spikes. plan: +10% every 10m across interleaved cohorts (A->B->A...). fallback is immediate drain back to pinned v2.1.2 and ff disable.

cheng: telemetry hooks: I'll watch `router.latency.p50`, `router.errors.rate` and `kvcache.hit_rate`. Also watching token-per-request regression on the eval set. If p75 latency increases > 30ms for two consecutive steps -> hold and triage.

ryan: add two safety knobs: 1) automatic backpressure at queue depth > 50 (soft drain), 2) enforce sticky-cohort TTL=15m so users aren't bounced mid-session.

michelle: noted. setting soft drain rule and cohort TTL. also adding a manual rollback button in console (michelle -> ops).

deploy-bot: rollout step 1: cohorts A,B updated to 10% each. responses: ok. observed p50=145ms, errors=0.12%, kvcache=72%

sam: looking at traces — small increase in tail latency on CPU-bound racks, nothing alarming yet.

cheng: step 2 holdpoint ready. will wait for 2m of steady telemetry before advancing.

michelle: if we see error rate > 0.5% or p50 > 200ms OR regressions on eval prompts (>=2/10 failures) -> rollback plan: run `/deploy ff disable llm_route_v2 --force` and pin back `model-v2.1.2` and trigger `releasebot` to notify customers. ops-runbook: mark incident, tag release notes.

oncall-bot: alert rule set: `router.errors.rate > 0.5%` or `router.latency.p50 > 200ms` for 3m -> paging oncall.

deploy-bot: step 2: advanced to 20% per plan. telemetry snapshot: p50=162ms, p95=420ms, errors=0.19%, kvcache=70%

ryan: p95 a bit up — which racks? I'm seeing spike on eu-west-2-gpu-3. can we throttle that shard?

michelle: pausing advancement. rolling back that shard to v2.1.2 (pin) and draining new connections from that host. sam/ryan, can you follow up on infra dygraph?

sam: ack. I'll open a short infra ticket and follow the shard.

cheng: after shard pin, re-eval step 2 metrics for 5m. if stable, we'll resume zipper at 10% increments and extend observation window to 15m for next steps.

michelle: thanks all. I'll update release notes with the zipper details and the rollback criteria. tagging SRE and support. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: summary posted to release channel and appended to changelog: "zipper rollout — llm_route_v2; pinned model-v2.2.0; paused due to p95 spike on eu-west-2-gpu-3; shard pinned back to v2.1.2; awaiting infra patch"

michelle: leaving this thread open — will post resume timestamp or full rollback decision here.
